references.text: Jotham also fled from Abimelech, illustrating a pattern where opponents of Abimelech must flee to escape his aggression.
A similar scene where enemies are pursued and many fall by the sword, describing warfare during the time of the Judges.
The Benjamites fled, and the Israelites pursued them, reflecting the same pattern of pursuit and flight in battle.
The Israelites pursued the enemy to the city gate, a similar scenario involving combat at the city gate.
The Israelites were pursued to the gate, showing the city gate as an important location in military confrontations.
Many fell in battle at the city gate, demonstrating the gate as a strategic and deadly place in warfare.
